status: Round 1. Exploratory concepts; awaiting user choice. Not installed in app.
observations: Existing Judge Bite uses intricate wood grain, wig curls and robe folds that lose definition at small UI sizes.
Existing UI combines comic display type, hard shadows, thick borders, gradients and a repeated large mascot.
Explore simpler silhouettes, food-first hierarchy, calmer surfaces and concentrated use of orange.

proposedDesign.name: The warm food court
principles: Warm ivory canvas with dark ink typography and orange primary actions.
One unmistakable primary action per screen.
The chosen mascot welcomes on Home and reacts during deliberation and verdicts.
Food names and verdict reasoning receive priority over decorative UI.
Fun, Healthy, Fit and Quick remain the app's existing objectives.
flow: Home: a clear food dilemma headline, one start action, quiet recent verdict rows.
Decision: 2–5 food option cards, optional photos and notes, compact goal controls, clear submit action.
Verdict: winner first, concise rationale, optional other rankings, share and start again.
proposedDesign.note: Concept proposal only; existing application files and launcher icons remain unchanged until the user chooses a direction.
